notes.title: Updated to ver1.03a.
notes.content:
→ver1.03a
・Fixed a case in which the judgment of stacking was incorrectly generated, which was corrected in ver1.03.

notes.title: →Updated to ver1.03.
notes.content:
→ver1.03
Fixed a problem in which other moving objects were being superimposed on the bouncing shimeji after it bounced.
Fixed a missing character in the font.（Japanese）
Fixed a bug that allowed bombs to be placed on the torii（Warp）.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.02.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing with us, reporting problems, etc.

→ver1.02
・Fixed a problem in which the bouncing shimeji mushrooms became too large if they were stepped on continuously.
・Fixed the rotation behavior when placing a mechanism that grants mobility on a mechanism that can rotate.
・Attribute-imparting mechanism cannot be set on a mechanism that already has that attribute.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.01
notes.content:
Thanks for playing!
We have been able to correct some of the behaviors you reported, and will update this page.

→ver1.01
・Mouse cursor only moves to a certain range of the window when the screen resolution is changed.
This bug has been fixed. We would appreciate it if you could let us know if this bug still happens.

・Fixed a problem in which dragging a moveable object and pressing right-click at the moment of release could result in incorrect placement coordinates.

notes.title: English image added.
notes.content:
The images in the story are now in English.
The version notation has not been changed. I often forget!

（I'm sure there are a lot of things wrong with the English, but if you could tell me if this is the way to do it, I'd be glad to know.）

notes.title: -Kokorowa Onigiri Delivery- will be released on 2024/7/5.
notes.content:
-Kokorowa Onigiri Delivery- will be released on 2024/7/5.
We will continue to fix bugs and adjust stages after release.
I don't think there is any level of basic playability that will be inconvenient,
We hope you will understand that changes will be made shortly after release.
Thank you for your cooperation!
